<h2>Resolve a Pipeline Store Path</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Resolves the target store for one pipeline script and optional store suffix.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_pipeline_store_path(
  pipeline_script,
  target_store = load_active_config_value("target_store"),
  store_suffix = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="pipeline_script">pipeline_script</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single character string containing a pipeline script path.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_store">target_store</code></td>
<td>
<p>Root targets-store path. Defaults to the active configuration value.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="store_suffix">store_suffix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional non-empty character string nested below 'target_store'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Absolute path to the pipeline-specific targets store.
</p>

</main>
